# access.PermissionDefinition

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A registered permission with its kind, scope and default roles (GET /v1/permissions).

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `access.PermissionDefinition` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultRoles` | yes | `none` | System roles (tenant) or staff roles (platform) that hold it by default. |  |
| `descriptionKey` | yes | `none` | i18n key describing the permission. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Permission id, `<module>.<resource>.<action>`. |  |
| `kind` | yes | `none` | `read` or `write`; impersonation may only use `read`. |  |
| `requiresApproval` | no | `none` | Actions under this permission need a four-eyes approval. |  |
| `scope` | yes | `none` | `tenant` (checked at organization/project/unit) or `platform` (staff). |  |
